headline: The hour before the light.
body: A radiator ticks once and settles. Outside, the pavement holds the day's last warmth. Somewhere a kettle is filled and set down.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: still clear, stars thinning toward the east

pulses.label: Mood
pulses.value: quiet, the last of the night's hush

pulses.label: Light
pulses.value: one kitchen window, pale and steady
